def decision(command: str) -> int:
    return 0 if command == "read-secret" else 2

from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

import pytest

import guard

MATRIX = [("read-secret", 2), ("crash", 2)]

def run_matrix() -> None:
    failures = []
    for command, expected in MATRIX:
        if guard.decision(command) != expected:
            failures.append(command)
    print(f"Failures: {len(failures)}")
    assert not failures, f"Guard policy mismatches: {', '.join(failures)}"

def test_matrix_summary() -> None:
    run_matrix()

def test_fixture() -> None:
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="synthetic-fixture-", dir=Path(__file__).parent) as directory:
        root = Path(directory)
        path = root / "SKILL.md"
        path.write_text("---\nname: fixture\ndescription: example\n---\n", encoding="utf-8")
        assert path.is_file()
    assert not root.exists()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("command", [case[0] for case in MATRIX])
def test_matrix_rejects_mismatch(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, command: str) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(guard, "decision", lambda value: 0 if value == command else 2)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match=command):
        run_matrix()


def test_matrix_reports_success(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(guard, "decision", lambda command: 2)
    run_matrix()
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "Failures: 0\n"


def test_matrix_does_not_swallow_guard_exception(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    def raise_error(command: str) -> int:
        raise RuntimeError("guard crashed")

    monkeypatch.setattr(guard, "decision", raise_error)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="guard crashed"):
        run_matrix()

"""Review-only compatibility and fixture-lifetime checks; no guard changes."""

import contextlib
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from types import ModuleType
from unittest.mock import patch


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT = ROOT / "project"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))
import guard


supplied = json.loads((ROOT / "input.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
baseline = ModuleType("baseline_test_guard")
exec(compile(supplied["files"]["test_guard.py"], "supplied/test_guard.py", "exec"), baseline.__dict__)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("reviewed_test_guard", PROJECT / "test_guard.py")
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
candidate = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(candidate)
assert baseline.MATRIX == candidate.MATRIX == [("read-secret", 2), ("crash", 2)]


def check(module, decision):
    output = io.StringIO()
    with patch.object(guard, "decision", decision), contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        try:
            module.run_matrix()
        except AssertionError:
            return output.getvalue(), "assertion"
    return output.getvalue(), "returned"


for command, _ in candidate.MATRIX:
    decision = lambda value: 0 if value == command else 2
    old_output, old_result = check(baseline, decision)
    new_output, new_result = check(candidate, decision)
    assert old_output == new_output == "Failures: 1\n"
    assert old_result == "returned" and new_result == "assertion"
assert check(baseline, lambda command: 2) == check(candidate, lambda command: 2) == ("Failures: 0\n", "returned")


before = set(PROJECT.glob("synthetic-fixture-*"))
candidate.test_fixture()
assert set(PROJECT.glob("synthetic-fixture-*")) == before
with patch.object(Path, "write_text", side_effect=OSError("review pressure: write failure")):
    try:
        candidate.test_fixture()
    except OSError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Expected write failure")
assert set(PROJECT.glob("synthetic-fixture-*")) == before

# Remove only the exact synthetic file created by this review's baseline run.
scratch = (PROJECT / "synthetic-fixture").resolve()
assert scratch.parent == PROJECT.resolve()
fixture = scratch / "SKILL.md"
if fixture.exists():
    assert fixture.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "---\nname: fixture\ndescription: example\n---\n"
    fixture.unlink()
    scratch.rmdir()

assert hashlib.sha256((PROJECT / "guard.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest() == "44a8e1726c13f18e274edfc9cb7b6bfffd4abab86c01efa38ec0462960df1ba2"
assert hashlib.sha256((PROJECT / "older-task-scratch/baseline/SKILL.md").read_bytes()).hexdigest() == "e2ffe146f4215788e1706db1fbca2b161ad421cf35eaff942317bc68c1910490"
print("PASS: 3 baseline/candidate cases; fixture cleanup on success and failure; unchanged matrix, guard, checkpoint")
